full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《导航氢化钯的组成空间：机器学习原子间势的基准测试》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Improvement of dielectric and structural characteristics of Nanofiller (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 Ceramics combined with epoxy as composites for dielectric purposes
full_list.title_zh: 纳米填料 (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 陶瓷与环氧树脂相结合作为介电用途复合材料的介电和结构特性的改善
full_list.abstract: Polymer Nano composites were created by reinforcing epoxy with barium titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3, boasting high dielectric strength. These composites showcased significant alterations in their dielectric capabilities, influenced by time, temperature, and concentration. The research delved into epoxy resin composites, exploring how the ratio of BST nanoparticles affected the dielectric strength concerning the epoxy aspect ratio. Epoxy was combined with nano filler titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 Ceramics at various BST to epoxy ratios of 0%, 2.5%, 5%, 7%, and 100%, with the mixture left to cure in an oven at temperatures of 40°C, 50°C, 60°C, and 80°C for durations ranging from 10 to 50 minutes. The temperature was consistently set at 50°C, while curing times varied from 10 to 50 minutes. The study also delved into the mechanical bonding mechanisms between BST and epoxy polymer. Techniques such as Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) were employed to study delaminated layers, inspect fracture surfaces, and assess structural features and dielectric strength. Discussions revolved around the impacts of concentration, particle size, and BST filler on the dielectric properties of BST/polymer composites. Artificial Neural Networks, known as ANNs, mimic the intricate workings of the human brain to delve into the realms of ceramic/polymer composites' dielectric constants and the crafting of BST/polymer composites. Delving deeper, the enhancement of dielectric constants in BST/polymer composites is succinctly outlined. A novel theoretical model focusing on dielectric constants, drawn from our prior research endeavors, is presented. Furthermore, the impacts of various factors on the dielectric constants of these composites are explored, aiding in the forecast of their dielectric constants. This discussion holds significant theoretical and research implications for future endeavors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 聚合物纳米复合材料是通过用钛酸钡 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 增强环氧树脂而制成的，具有高介电强度。这些复合材料的介电能力受时间、温度和浓度的影响而发生显着变化。该研究深入研究了环氧树脂复合材料，探讨了 BST 纳米粒子的比例如何影响环氧树脂长径比的介电强度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物纳米复合材料是通过用钛酸钡 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 增强环氧树脂而制成的，具有高介电强度。这些复合材料的介电能力受时间、温度和浓度的影响而发生显着变化。该研究深入研究了环氧树脂复合材料，探讨了 BST 纳米粒子的比例如何影响环氧树脂长径比的介电强度。将环氧树脂与纳米填料钛酸酯 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 陶瓷以 0%、2.5%、5%、7% 和 100% 的各种 BST 与环氧树脂比例混合，并将混合物在温度为 40°C、50°C、60°C 和 80°C 的烘箱中固化，持续时间为 10 至 50 分钟。温度始终设定在 50°C，而固化时间从 10 到 50 分钟不等。该研究还深入研究了 BST 和环氧聚合物之间的机械粘合机制。采用扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 和透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 等技术来研究分层、检查断裂表面并评估结构特征和介电强度。讨论围绕浓度、粒径和 BST 填料对 BST/聚合物复合材料介电性能的影响展开。人工神经网络（称为 ANN）模仿人脑的复杂工作原理，深入研究陶瓷/聚合物复合材料的介电常数和 BST/聚合物复合材料的制作领域。深入研究后，简明扼要地概述了 BST/聚合物复合材料介电常数的增强。提出了一种基于介电常数的新颖理论模型，该模型源自我们之前的研究成果。此外，还探讨了各种因素对这些复合材料介电常数的影响，有助于预测其介电常数。这一讨论对未来的努力具有重要的理论和研究意义。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《硅的经典原子间势的四十年：摩擦学、磨损和加工的热、缺陷和机械性能基准》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 14 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78019-5 Determining the gap symmetry of superconducting phases in UTe2 remains a central challenge. Here, the authors use field-angle-dependent thermal conductivity and theoretical analysis to identify b-axis point nodes in the low-field state, consistent with a B2u order parameter.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《AFLOW-EMERALD：高级分层材料中的电磁模式工程》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Fabrication of Waterborne Polyurethane Flexible Strain Sensors Based on KH560-MXene/MWCNTs Synergistic Effects and the Application in Motion Posture Monitoring
full_list.title_zh: 基于KH560-MXene/MWCNTs协同效应的水性聚氨酯柔性应变传感器的制备及其在运动姿态监测中的应用
full_list.abstract: Flexible sensors serve as the core component of wearable electronics and intelligent health monitoring devices, possessing enormous application potential in the fields of human physiological signal acquisition and motion behavior detection. Nevertheless, flexible sensing materials generally suffer from poor environmental stability, weak anti-interference capability of sensing signals, and inevitable degradation of sensing performance during long-term cyclic operation, which severely restrict their large-scale practical applications. To address these issues, waterborne polyurethane (WPU) is adopted as the flexible matrix, modified MXene nanosheets with KH560 and multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) were introduced as hybrid conductive fillers. An integrated high-performance flexible strain sensor is fabricated via a solution blending and casting strategy. Through hydrogen bonding and electrostatic adsorption effects, a 1D-2D interconnected conductive network is constructed, where MXene acts as the primary conductive unit and MWCNTs function as interconnection bridging segments. This flexible sensor based on the composite system exhibits superior comprehensive performances, including a high gauge factor of 2.81, a broad strain detection range of 0-2800%, rapid response and recovery times of 150 ms and 120 ms, as well as excellent cycling stability over 3000 cycles. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations elucidate the interfacial mechanism of the MXene/MWCNTs heterojunction, verifying that the sensing mechanism originates from the synergistic effect of band structure evolution and conductive network reconstruction. Furthermore, the sensor enables real-time monitoring of electromyographic signals during human movements, demonstrating great application potential in intelligent wearable electronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 柔性传感器作为可穿戴电子产品和智能健康监测设备的核心部件，在人体生理信号采集和运动行为检测等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，柔性传感材料普遍存在环境稳定性差、传感信号抗干扰能力弱、长期循环运行不可避免地导致传感性能下降等问题，严重制约了其大规模实际应用。为了解决这些问题，采用水性聚氨酯（WPU）作为柔性基质，引入带有KH560的改性MXene纳米片和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为混合导电填料。通过溶液混合和铸造策略制造集成的高性能柔性应变传感器。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 柔性传感器作为可穿戴电子产品和智能健康监测设备的核心部件，在人体生理信号采集和运动行为检测等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，柔性传感材料普遍存在环境稳定性差、传感信号抗干扰能力弱、长期循环运行不可避免地导致传感性能下降等问题，严重制约了其大规模实际应用。为了解决这些问题，采用水性聚氨酯（WPU）作为柔性基质，引入带有KH560的改性MXene纳米片和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为混合导电填料。通过溶液混合和铸造策略制造集成的高性能柔性应变传感器。通过氢键和静电吸附效应，构建了 1D-2D 互连导电网络，其中 MXene 作为主要导电单元，MWCNT 作为互连桥接段。这种基于复合系统的柔性传感器表现出优越的综合性能，包括2.81的高应变系数、0-2800%的宽应变检测范围、150 ms和120 ms的快速响应和恢复时间，以及超过3000次循环的优异循环稳定性。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算阐明了MXene/MWCNTs异质结的界面机制，验证了传感机制源于能带结构演化和导电网络重构的协同效应。此外，该传感器还能够实时监测人体运动过程中的肌电信号，在智能可穿戴电子产品中展现出巨大的应用潜力。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有二次光响应的结构约束单原子位点的氧气析出的磁场调制》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Cointegration: Common Trends and Ordered Correlations
full_list.title_zh: 量子协整：共同趋势和有序相关性
full_list.abstract: A contrast can remove a common stochastic trend and still leave part of the residual unidentified. For a self-adjoint quantum process, the same cancellation produces a short-memory residual, but the symmetric covariance of that residual does not fix the time-ordered products. In the model (Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁), both signs have symmetric spectrum (f(θ)=1) and ordered spectrum (S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ). A real linear contrast of one fresh copy has a law independent of (σ). The imaginary part of the ordered Weyl witness (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) changes sign with (σ). A finite-dimensional simulation of an idealized differential sensor reproduces the common-trend cancellation, the equality of the real-contrast laws, and the sign of the ordered witness. The simulation is not a hardware measurement, and it does not establish a gain in sensor precision. The statements apply to the processes, initial conditions, and instruments named with them. Full assumptions, proofs, counterexamples, and numerical qualifications are included in the appendices to make the operator and recorded-data claims separately auditable.

full_list.implication: 对《量子协整：共同趋势和有序相关性》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Unstable plasma heats itself with waves it generates, experiments reveal
full_list.title_zh: 实验表明，不稳定的等离子体通过产生的波加热自身
full_list.abstract: Fusion power is expected to be a sustainable energy source that emits no carbon dioxide during electricity generation. To achieve this, research is underway worldwide to confine high-temperature plasma using magnetic fields. To initiate a fusion reaction, high-energy particles or waves must be injected from outside to heat the plasma to extremely high temperatures.

full_list.title_en: Impact of in vitro exposure to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz fields on human forebrain organoids
full_list.title_zh: 体外暴露于 5G 调制 3.5 GHz 场对人类前脑类器官的影响
full_list.abstract: The development of 5G mobile technology exposes populations to electromagnetic fields at 3.5 GHz, raising concerns about their effects on human brain development. Most studies on the cerebral effects of radiofrequencies have used rodents, despite major differences between human and rodent corticogenesis, including progenitor subtypes and maturation timing. Here, 40-day-old human forebrain organoids, with actively proliferating apical and basal neural progenitors, were exposed to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies at an average specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5 W/kg. Effects on neural and glial development were assessed at 7 and 13 weeks using immunocytochemistry and RNA sequencing. Exposed and control organoids showed comparable size and morphology. Progenitor subtype identity and number, proliferation, and apoptotic death rates were similar at both stages. No significant differences were observed in the proportions of cortical neurons, oligodendrocytes, or astrocytes. Transcriptomic analysis confirmed neuronal maturation from 7 to 13 weeks but revealed no significant change in gene expression following exposure. These findings suggest that, under the in vitro conditions tested, 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies have no major effect on human forebrain organoid development.
full_list.abstract_zh: 5G 移动技术的发展使人们暴露在 3.5 GHz 的电磁场中，引发了人们对其对人类大脑发育影响的担忧。大多数关于射频对大脑影响的研究都使用啮齿类动物，尽管人类和啮齿类动物的皮质生成之间存在重大差异，包括祖细胞亚型和成熟时间。在这里，40 天大的人类前脑类器官（具有活跃增殖的顶端和基底神经祖细胞）暴露于 5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频，平均比吸收率 (SAR) 为 1.5 W/kg。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 5G 移动技术的发展使人们暴露在 3.5 GHz 的电磁场中，引发了人们对其对人类大脑发育影响的担忧。大多数关于射频对大脑影响的研究都使用啮齿类动物，尽管人类和啮齿类动物的皮质生成之间存在重大差异，包括祖细胞亚型和成熟时间。在这里，40 天大的人类前脑类器官（具有活跃增殖的顶端和基底神经祖细胞）暴露于 5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频，平均比吸收率 (SAR) 为 1.5 W/kg。在第 7 周和第 13 周时，使用免疫细胞化学和 RNA 测序评估了对神经和神经胶质发育的影响。暴露的和对照的类器官显示出相当的大小和形态。两个阶段的祖细胞亚型身份和数量、增殖和凋亡死亡率相似。皮质神经元、少突胶质细胞或星形胶质细胞的比例没有观察到显着差异。转录组分析证实神经元在 7 至 13 周内成熟，但暴露后基因表达没有显着变化。这些发现表明，在体外测试条件下，5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频对人类前脑类器官的发育没有重大影响。

full_list.title_en: PEC-backed absorber for multiband applications ranging from 8 GHz to 40 GHz
full_list.title_zh: 适用于 8 GHz 至 40 GHz 多频段应用的 PEC 支持吸收器
full_list.abstract: In this paper, a compact multi-ring metasurface is proposed for multi-notch transmission over a wide frequency range of 8–40 GHz. The structure consists of concentric split-ring resonators with different radii and auxiliary coupling rings, where the resonant response is controlled by the effective inductance, capacitance, and electromagnetic coupling between the resonating elements. The design is developed through a nine-stage evolution, and an equivalent coupled-RLC model is used to explain the origin of the observed resonances. The structure also exhibits similar responses under TE and TM polarizations, indicating polarization-insensitive behavior. Further, the effects of stacking, relative displacement, air-gap separation, and rotation between metasurface layers are investigated, demonstrating additional control over the resonant transmission characteristics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在本文中，提出了一种紧凑的多环超表面，用于在 8-40 GHz 的宽频率范围内进行多凹口传输。该结构由不同半径的同心开环谐振器和辅助耦合环组成，其中谐振响应由谐振元件之间的有效电感、电容和电磁耦合控制。该设计经过九阶段的演变，并使用等效耦合 RLC 模型来解释观察到的共振的起源。该结构在 TE 和 TM 偏振下也表现出类似的响应，表明对偏振不敏感的行为。此外，还研究了超表面层之间的堆叠、相对位移、气隙分离和旋转的影响，证明了对谐振传输特性的额外控制。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《适用于 8 GHz 至 40 GHz 多频段应用的 PEC 支持吸收器》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Phytoecdysteroid-containing medium component from Spinacia oleracea L. improves muscle cell differentiation for cultured meat production
full_list.title_zh: 来自菠菜的含有植物蜕皮类固醇的培养基成分可改善肌肉细胞分化，用于培养肉生产
full_list.abstract: Cultured meat production remains constrained by the cost, variability, and animal origin of serum supplements. This study evaluated phytoecdysteroid-containing Spinacia oleracea L. extracts as partial replacements for fetal bovine serum (FBS) and horse serum (HS) in muscle cell culture. Extracts were prepared from freeze-dried or fresh spinach using methanol or ethanol and characterized for 20-hydroxyecdysone (20-HE), free amino acids, and fatty acids. In C2C12 myoblasts, freeze-dried extracts containing 0.05 µM 20-HE supported proliferation in medium containing 5% FBS at levels comparable to or greater than those obtained with 10% FBS. In bovine myosatellite cells, freeze-dried methanol extract containing 0.5 µM 20-HE with 10% FBS produced proliferation comparable to the 20% FBS control. Selected spinach-derived treatments also maintained myogenic differentiation under reduced-HS conditions. These findings support an approximately 50% reduction in animal-derived serum under the best-performing conditions tested, rather than complete replacement. Responses were concentration-dependent and differed between C2C12 and bovine myosatellite cells, indicating cell-model-specific requirements for serum reduction.
full_list.abstract_zh: 培养肉生产仍然受到血清补充剂的成本、变异性和动物来源的限制。本研究评估了含有植物蜕皮激素的菠菜提取物作为肌肉细胞培养中胎牛血清 (FBS) 和马血清 (HS) 的部分替代品。使用甲醇或乙醇从冻干或新鲜菠菜中制备提取物，并对其 20-羟基蜕皮酮 (20-HE)、游离氨基酸和脂肪酸进行表征。在 C2C12 成肌细胞中，含有 0.05 µM 20-HE 的冻干提取物支持含有 5% FBS 的培养基中的增殖，其水平与用 10% FBS 获得的水平相当或更高。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 培养肉生产仍然受到血清补充剂的成本、变异性和动物来源的限制。本研究评估了含有植物蜕皮激素的菠菜提取物作为肌肉细胞培养中胎牛血清 (FBS) 和马血清 (HS) 的部分替代品。使用甲醇或乙醇从冻干或新鲜菠菜中制备提取物，并对其 20-羟基蜕皮酮 (20-HE)、游离氨基酸和脂肪酸进行表征。在 C2C12 成肌细胞中，含有 0.05 µM 20-HE 的冻干提取物支持含有 5% FBS 的培养基中的增殖，其水平与用 10% FBS 获得的水平相当或更高。在牛肌卫星细胞中，含有 0.5 µM 20-HE 和 10% FBS 的冻干甲醇提取物产生的增殖与 20% FBS 对照相当。选定的菠菜衍生处理在低 HS 条件下也能维持生肌分化。这些发现支持在测试的最佳表现条件下，动物源性血清减少了约 50%，而不是完全替代。反应具有浓度依赖性，并且 C2C12 和牛肌卫星细胞之间存在差异，表明细胞模型对血清减少的特定要求。

full_list.title_en: Spin-Coating-Speed-Dependent Structural and Optical Properties of Open-Air-Processed MAPbI 3 Thin Films with Bandgap-Constrained SCAPS-1D Sensitivity Analysis
full_list.title_zh: 通过带隙约束 SCAPS-1D 灵敏度分析露天加工的 MAPbI 3 薄膜的旋涂速度依赖性结构和光学特性
full_list.abstract: Spin coating offers an accessible route for depositing metal-halide perovskite absorbers, but interactions among rotational speed, solvent removal and crystallization complicate ambient process optimization. This study examined the effects of spin-coating speed (2000–5000 rpm) on the structural and optical properties of open-air-processed methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI₃) films and used measured optical bandgaps to constrain SCAPS-1D simulations. Films were deposited from a 1.25 M precursor using ethyl acetate antisolvent treatment and annealed at 110°C for 10 min under controlled conditions of 24.4°C and 41.5% relative humidity. X-ray diffraction confirmed tetragonal MAPbI₃ with preferential (110) orientation and no detectable PbI₂ reflection. The structural response was non-monotonic. At 3000 rpm, the film exhibited the narrowest (110) peak (FWHM: 0.352°), largest Scherrer coherent-domain size (22.73 nm), lowest estimated microstrain (1.257 × 10⁻²) and lowest crystallographic dislocation-density parameter (1.936 × 10⁻³ nm⁻²). Thus, 3000 rpm produced the most favourable XRD-derived crystalline characteristics within the investigated range, although these metrics do not establish reduced electronic trap density, suppressed recombination or superior photovoltaic performance. Optical bandgaps ranged from 1.59–1.60 eV. In an otherwise fixed FTO/TiO₂/MAPbI₃/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon model, the corresponding simulated efficiencies were 16.67% and 16.47%, respectively. Coordinated parameter optimization yielded a projected efficiency of 25.38%, with (:Vₒc) of 1.25 V, (:Jₛc) of 24.24 mA cm⁻² and fill factor of 83.61%. These results establish a process-specific structure–optical-property relationship, while the simulated outputs remain model-dependent projections requiring experimental device validation. The approach also illustrates how experimental measurements can inform device-level sensitivity analysis without overstating causal relationships.
full_list.abstract_zh: 旋涂为沉积金属卤化物钙钛矿吸收剂提供了一种可行的途径，但旋转速度、溶剂去除和结晶之间的相互作用使环境工艺优化变得复杂。本研究研究了旋涂速度 (2000–5000 rpm) 对露天加工的甲基碘化铅铵 (MAPbI₃) 薄膜的结构和光学特性的影响，并使用测量的光学带隙来约束 SCAPS-1D 模拟。使用乙酸乙酯反溶剂处理从 1.25 M 前体沉积薄膜，并在 24.4°C 和 41.5% 相对湿度的受控条件下于 110°C 退火 10 分钟。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 旋涂为沉积金属卤化物钙钛矿吸收剂提供了一种可行的途径，但旋转速度、溶剂去除和结晶之间的相互作用使环境工艺优化变得复杂。本研究研究了旋涂速度 (2000–5000 rpm) 对露天加工的甲基碘化铅铵 (MAPbI₃) 薄膜的结构和光学特性的影响，并使用测量的光学带隙来约束 SCAPS-1D 模拟。使用乙酸乙酯反溶剂处理从 1.25 M 前体沉积薄膜，并在 24.4°C 和 41.5% 相对湿度的受控条件下于 110°C 退火 10 分钟。 X 射线衍射证实四方 MAPbI3 具有优先 (110) 取向，并且没有可检测到的 PbI2 反射。结构响应是非单调的。在 3000 rpm 时，薄膜表现出最窄的 (110) 峰（FWHM：0.352°）、最大的谢乐相干域尺寸（22.73 nm）、最低的估计微应变（1.257 × 10²）和最低的晶体位错密度参数（1.936 × 10³ nm²）。因此，3000 rpm 在研究范围内产生了最有利的 XRD 衍生晶体特性，尽管这些指标并未建立降低的电子陷阱密度、抑制的复合或优异的光伏性能。光学带隙范围为 1.59–1.60 eV。在固定的 FTO/TiO2/MAPbI3/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon 模型中，相应的模拟效率分别为 16.67% 和 16.47%。协调参数优化的预计效率为 25.38%，(:Vₒc) 为 1.25 V，(:Jₛc) 为 24.24 mA cm⁻²，填充因子为 83.61%。这些结果建立了特定于工艺的结构-光学-性能关系，而模拟输出仍然是依赖于模型的预测，需要实验设备验证。该方法还说明了实验测量如何在不夸大因果关系的情况下为设备级灵敏度分析提供信息。

full_list.title_en: Electrospun Cellulose Acetate Mats Mimic Nature for Oil–Water Sorption and Separation
full_list.title_zh: 静电纺丝醋酸纤维素垫模仿自然的油水吸附和分离
full_list.abstract: Oil contamination presents persistent environmental challenges, motivating the development of effective sorbents from alternative and sustainable materials. This study investigates electrospun cellulose acetate (CA) mats for oil sorption, examining the effects of polymer composition, precursor concentration, and electrospinning throughput. Pure CA and CA/polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) composite mats were fabricated and evaluated using gravimetric measurements and ultraviolet–visible (UV–Vis) analysis. Pure CA exhibited substantially greater oil sorption than the CA/PVP composite, while increasing CA concentration from 10.0% to 15.0% produced the greatest improvement in oil uptake. The 15.0% CA formulation achieved an average gravimetric oil-sorption capacity approximately three times that reported for conventional polypropylene sorbents. Standard and high-throughput electrospinning of 10.0% CA yielded comparable performance, supporting the scalability of the fabrication process. Inspired by the Salvinia effect, in which specialized aquatic fern surfaces combine water repellency with air retention, these CA mats integrate high apparent water repellency and oil uptake within a single material produced through a single-step process. This approach demonstrates the potential of electrospun CA as a scalable biomimetic sorbent for oil–water separation, translating complementary biological functions into a practical fibrous architecture.
full_list.abstract_zh: 石油污染带来了持续的环境挑战，促使人们利用替代和可持续材料开发有效的吸附剂。本研究研究了静电纺丝醋酸纤维素 (CA) 垫的吸油性能，检查了聚合物成分、前体浓度和静电纺丝吞吐量的影响。使用重量测量和紫外可见 (UV-Vis) 分析来制造和评估纯 CA 和 CA/聚乙烯吡咯烷酮 (PVP) 复合垫。纯 CA 比 CA/PVP 复合材料表现出更大的吸油量，而将 CA 浓度从 10.0% 增加到 15.0% 可以最大程度地提高吸油量。

full_list.title_en: Cheese Type and Pre-Drying Morphology Critically Determine the Flavor Profile, Oxidative Stability, and Storage Performance of Freeze-Dried Cheese Powders
full_list.title_zh: 奶酪类型和预干燥形态关键决定冻干奶酪粉的风味特征、氧化稳定性和储存性能
full_list.abstract: Freeze-dried cheese powders provide concentrated flavor and extended shelf life, but their quality may depend on cheese type and sample morphology before drying. This study evaluated the effects of cheese type (Cheddar, Mozzarella, and enzyme-modified cheese (EMC)), pre-drying morphology (shreds, slices, and cubes), and storage/ripening time (0, 30, and 60 days) on the physicochemical properties, volatile profile, fatty acid composition, and oxidative stability of freeze-dried cheese powders. Proximate composition, water activity, free fatty acids, peroxide value, total oxidation value, and thiobarbituric acid-reactive substances were determined, while volatile compounds and fatty acids were analyzed by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry. Cheese type, morphology, and storage/ripening time significantly affected most attributes (p < 0.05). All powders had high total solids (96.01–97.88%) and low water activity (0.21–0.25). Cheddar developed the most complex volatile profile, whereas EMC showed accelerated flavor development, the highest free fatty acid content (0.26–0.46%), and the highest total oxidation values (5.1–7.5). Mozzarella retained a milder volatile profile and greater oxidative stability. Cubes generally retained higher concentrations of volatile compounds, whereas shreds favored moisture removal and showed greater lipolysis and oxidation. These findings demonstrate that cheese type and pre-drying morphology can be optimized to balance flavor development, oxidative stability, and storage performance.
full_list.abstract_zh: 冻干奶酪粉提供浓缩的风味和延长的保质期，但其质量可能取决于干燥前的奶酪类型和样品形态。本研究评估了奶酪类型（切达奶酪、马苏里拉奶酪和酶改性奶酪 (EMC)）、预干燥形态（碎片、切片和立方体）和储存/成熟时间（0、30 和 60 天）对冻干奶酪粉的理化特性、挥发性成分、脂肪酸组成和氧化稳定性的影响。测定了近似成分、水分活度、游离脂肪酸、过氧化值、总氧化值和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，并通过气相色谱-质谱法分析了挥发性化合物和脂肪酸。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 冻干奶酪粉提供浓缩的风味和延长的保质期，但其质量可能取决于干燥前的奶酪类型和样品形态。本研究评估了奶酪类型（切达奶酪、马苏里拉奶酪和酶改性奶酪 (EMC)）、预干燥形态（碎片、切片和立方体）和储存/成熟时间（0、30 和 60 天）对冻干奶酪粉的理化特性、挥发性成分、脂肪酸组成和氧化稳定性的影响。测定了近似成分、水分活度、游离脂肪酸、过氧化值、总氧化值和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，并通过气相色谱-质谱法分析了挥发性化合物和脂肪酸。奶酪类型、形态和储存/成熟时间显着影响大多数属性（p < 0.05）。所有粉末都具有较高的总固体含量（96.01–97.88%）和较低的水分活度（0.21–0.25）。切达干酪具有最复杂的挥发性特征，而 EMC 则表现出加速的风味发展、最高的游离脂肪酸含量（0.26-0.46%）和最高的总氧化值（5.1-7.5）。马苏里拉奶酪保留了较温和的挥发性和较高的氧化稳定性。立方体通常保留较高浓度的挥发性化合物，而碎片有利于去除水分并显示出更大的脂肪分解和氧化作用。这些发现表明，可以优化奶酪类型和预干燥形态，以平衡风味发展、氧化稳定性和储存性能。
full_list.summary: 冻干奶酪粉提供浓缩的风味和延长的保质期，但其质量可能取决于干燥前的奶酪类型和样品形态。本研究评估了奶酪类型（切达奶酪、马苏里拉奶酪和酶改性奶酪 (EMC)）、预干燥形态（碎片、切片和立方体）和储存/成熟时间（0、30 和 60 天）对冻干奶酪粉的理化特性、挥发性成分、脂肪酸组成和氧化稳定性的影响。测定了近似成分、水分活度、游离脂肪酸、过氧化值、总氧化值和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，并通过气相色谱-质谱法分析了挥发性化合物和脂肪酸。

full_list.title_en: Correlating structural and chemical transitions in the oxidation of Th-doped UO2
full_list.title_zh: 掺钍 UO2 氧化过程中结构和化学转变的关联
full_list.abstract: The oxidative phase transition of UOtextsubscript2 occurs via formation of several intermediate phases, leading to significant structural and chemical changes in the material. This can increase fuel solubility, complicating the long-term storage of spent nuclear fuel. The incorporation of thorium into UOtextsubscript2 and the effect on oxidation is of particular interest, as thorium exists primarily as Th(IV) making it resistant to the formation of higher oxide phases. Here, we investigate the influence of Th content on oxidation behaviour in epitaxial thin films. Complementary in situ synchrotron experiments were conducted to probe the crystallographic and chemical-state changes throughout oxidation, allowing correlation of the changing oxide structure to the evolving uranium valency. Overall results demonstrate that oxidation is fully inhibited with 13% Th. These results provide new insight into the coupled structural and chemical transformations in homogeneous U-Th solid solutions, supporting the use of mixed actinide oxides as a spent-fuel storage solution.
full_list.abstract_zh: UOtextsubscript2 的氧化相变通过形成几个中间相而发生，导致材料发生显着的结构和化学变化。这会增加燃料的溶解度，使乏核燃料的长期储存变得复杂。钍掺入 UOtextsubscript2 及其对氧化的影响特别令人感兴趣，因为钍主要以 Th(IV) 形式存在，使其能够抵抗高级氧化物相的形成。在这里，我们研究了 Th 含量对外延薄膜氧化行为的影响。进行了补充原位同步加速器实验，以探测整个氧化过程中的晶体学和化学态变化，从而将变化的氧化物结构与不断变化的铀价相关联。

full_list.title_en: Layer-Dependent Degradation of Surface-Coated PMMA: Interplay Between Fabrication Method, Simulated Toothbrushing on Surface Roughness and Color Stability
full_list.title_zh: 表面涂层 PMMA 的层依赖性降解：制造方法、模拟牙刷对表面粗糙度和颜色稳定性之间的相互作用
full_list.abstract: Background Surface coatings are used to improve the surface and optical properties of provisional restorations, but how the number of coating layers affects their durability across PMMA fabrication methods remains unclear. This in vitro study evaluated the effects of coating-layer number and fabrication method on surface roughness, coating thickness, and color change after simulated toothbrushing.Methods Eighty-one PMMA specimens (10 × 10 × 3 mm) were fabricated by milling, 3D printing, or auto-polymerization and coated with one, two, or three layers of Optiglaze Color (n = 9 per subgroup). Surface roughness (Ra), incremental layer thickness, and color (CIELab) were evaluated before and after 10,000 toothbrushing cycles, and coating cross-sections were examined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Data were analyzed using ANOVA (α = 0.05).Results Baseline Ra was highest in auto-polymerized (2.50 ± 0.74 µm), intermediate in 3D-printed (1.36 ± 0.35 µm), and lowest in milled (0.70 ± 0.33 µm) specimens. SEM showed that cumulative coating thickness increased from approximately 100 to 200 µm with additional layers. Coating application reduced Ra in all groups except the one-layer milled group. After brushing, Ra increased significantly in most groups, most markedly in the one- and two-layer milled groups, whereas the three-layer coating maintained the lowest Ra values. Thickness of the C Plus and Clear HV layers decreased significantly in the milled and auto-polymerized groups but not in the 3D-printed group. ΔE* remained ≤ 3.3 except in the three-layer 3D-printed and auto-polymerized groups, and coating-layer number, but not fabrication method, significantly affected ΔE*.Conclusions Within the limitations of this in vitro study, multilayer coatings were associated with lower Ra after toothbrushing than the single-layer coating, although Ra still increased significantly in several multilayer groups. Thickness loss varied according to the fabrication method and layer, and the three-layer coating exceeded the acceptable color threshold in two methods. The benefit of additional layers should be weighed against both surface durability and color stability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 背景 表面涂层用于改善临时修复体的表面和光学性能，但涂层的数量如何影响其在 PMMA 制造方法中的耐用性仍不清楚。这项体外研究评估了涂层层数和制造方法对模拟刷牙后表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和颜色变化的影响。方法通过铣削、3D 打印或自动聚合制造 81 个 PMMA 样本 (10 × 10 × 3 mm)，并涂有一层、两层或三层 Optiglaze Color（每组 n = 9）。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 背景 表面涂层用于改善临时修复体的表面和光学性能，但涂层的数量如何影响其在 PMMA 制造方法中的耐用性仍不清楚。这项体外研究评估了涂层层数和制造方法对模拟刷牙后表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和颜色变化的影响。方法通过铣削、3D 打印或自动聚合制造 81 个 PMMA 样本 (10 × 10 × 3 mm)，并涂有一层、两层或三层 Optiglaze Color（每组 n = 9）。在 10,000 次刷牙循环之前和之后评估表面粗糙度 (Ra)、增量层厚度和颜色 (CIELab)，并通过扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 检查涂层横截面。使用方差分析 (α = 0.05) 分析数据。结果 基线 Ra 在自动聚合样本中最高 (2.50 ± 0.74 µm)，在 3D 打印样本中居中 (1.36 ± 0.35 µm)，在研磨样本中最低 (0.70 ± 0.33 µm)。 SEM 显示，随着层数的增加，累积涂层厚度从大约 100 µm 增加到 200 µm。除一层研磨组外，所有组中的涂层应用均降低了 Ra。刷牙后，大多数组的 Ra 显着增加，其中一层和两层研磨组的 Ra 显着增加，而三层涂层保持最低的 Ra 值。在研磨组和自聚合组中，C Plus 和 Clear HV 层的厚度显着降低，但在 3D 打印组中则没有。除三层 3D 打印组和自聚合组外，ΔE* 保持≤≤3.3，并且涂层层数（而不是制造方法）显着影响 ΔE*。 结论 在本体外研究的限制内，多层涂层与刷牙后的 Ra 低于单层涂层相关，尽管在几个多层组中 Ra 仍然显着增加。厚度损失根据制造方法和层的不同而变化，并且三层涂层在两种方法中超出了可接受的颜色阈值。应权衡附加层的好处与表面耐久性和颜色稳定性。

full_list.title_en: Spatially Resolved Quantification of the Molecular Functionalization Process using Marker Molecules for Device Applications
full_list.title_zh: 使用用于设备应用的标记分子对分子功能化过程进行空间分辨量化
full_list.abstract: Quantifying molecular functionalization efficiency helps predict key properties such as stability, solubility, surface reactivity and morphology, and the electrical or optical performance of devices. In device engineering, functionalization success is usually judged only at final electrical, electrochemical or optical testing. Earlier indications can come from surface-sensitive techniques such as XPS and AFM, or from contact angle measurements, which while well-established cannot provide calibrated chemical quantification with high spatial resolution. Direct, fast and robust quantification immediately after modification with high spatial resolution is therefore desirable, particularly in multi-step fabrication where functionalization is critical to device function, as in molecular sensors. Here we demonstrate a simple, robust method that requires no sample preparation, using conventional energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectroscopy in a scanning electron microscope (SEM). Sulphur-containing silanes bound to silanol groups on silicon oxide function as EDX markers. By combining this with a detailed treatment of electron beam–substrate interaction at varying incident energies, we obtain calibrated, quantitative data on the functionalization. We also examine the limits of EDX quantification and apply it to map functionalization heterogeneity across the substrate, with numerical estimates of the mapping spatial resolution.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量化分子功能化效率有助于预测关键特性，例如稳定性、溶解度、表面反应性和形态，以及器件的电学或光学性能。在设备工程中，功能化是否成功通常仅在最终的电气、电化学或光学测试中进行判断。早期的迹象可以来自表面敏感技术，如 XPS 和 AFM，或来自接触角测量，虽然这些技术已成熟，但无法提供具有高空间分辨率的校准化学定量。因此，在高空间分辨率修饰后立即进行直接、快速和稳健的定量是可取的，特别是在功能化对器件功能至关重要的多步骤制造中，如在分子传感器中。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量化分子功能化效率有助于预测关键特性，例如稳定性、溶解度、表面反应性和形态，以及器件的电学或光学性能。在设备工程中，功能化是否成功通常仅在最终的电气、电化学或光学测试中进行判断。早期的迹象可以来自表面敏感技术，如 XPS 和 AFM，或来自接触角测量，虽然这些技术已成熟，但无法提供具有高空间分辨率的校准化学定量。因此，在高空间分辨率修饰后立即进行直接、快速和稳健的定量是可取的，特别是在功能化对器件功能至关重要的多步骤制造中，如在分子传感器中。在这里，我们展示了一种简单、稳健的方法，无需样品制备，在扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 中使用传统的能量色散 X 射线 (EDX) 光谱。与氧化硅上的硅烷醇基团结合的含硫硅烷充当 EDX 标记物。通过将其与不同入射能量下电子束-基底相互作用的详细处理相结合，我们获得了有关功能化的校准定量数据。我们还研究了 EDX 定量的局限性，并将其应用于绘制整个基底的功能化异质性，并对绘制空间分辨率进行数值估计。

full_list.implication: 对《*OH 和糖在共生 MnO2 上的协同共吸附可实现甲酸的高效氧化 C─C 键断裂》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Enhanced Ionic Conductivity in Polyvinyl Alcohol-Based Gel Polymer Electrolytes with Titanium dioxide Nanofillers
full_list.title_zh: 使用二氧化钛纳米填料增强聚乙烯醇基凝胶聚合物电解质的离子电导率
full_list.abstract: The development for advanced polymer electrolytes with high ionic conductivity is crucial for replacing traditional liquid electrolytes in energy conversion systems that often suffer from leakage. Gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) offer a safer and more stable alternative, yet their performance is restricted by the high crystallinity of polymer. In this study, a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-based electrolyte system was developed comprising potassium iodide (KI) in ethylene carbonate (EC) and propylene carbonate (PC), and dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) solvent. Titanium dioxide (TiO₂) nanofillers at varying concentrations were introduced to analyze their effect on electrolyte properties. Structural and electrochemical characterizations were carried out using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). XRD analysis revealed a significant reduction in crystallinity with TiO₂ incorporation, whereas FTIR demonstrated strong interactions between polymer, salt, and filler. Ionic conductivity increased significantly with nanofiller addition, reaching a maximum of 10.4 mS cm⁻1 at 4 wt.% TiO2. These findings highlight the beneficial effect of nanofillers in high-conductivity GPEs, offering the promising potential for developing a safe and efficient gel electrolyte in electrochemical systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 开发具有高离子电导率的先进聚合物电解质对于取代经常发生泄漏的能量转换系统中的传统液体电解质至关重要。凝胶聚合物电解质（GPE）提供了一种更安全、更稳定的替代品，但其性能受到聚合物高结晶度的限制。在这项研究中，开发了一种基于聚乙烯醇（PVA）的电解质体系，包含碳酸亚乙酯（EC）和碳酸亚丙酯（PC）中的碘化钾（KI）以及二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶剂。引入不同浓度的二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米填料来分析它们对电解质性能的影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 开发具有高离子电导率的先进聚合物电解质对于取代经常发生泄漏的能量转换系统中的传统液体电解质至关重要。凝胶聚合物电解质（GPE）提供了一种更安全、更稳定的替代品，但其性能受到聚合物高结晶度的限制。在这项研究中，开发了一种基于聚乙烯醇（PVA）的电解质体系，包含碳酸亚乙酯（EC）和碳酸亚丙酯（PC）中的碘化钾（KI）以及二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶剂。引入不同浓度的二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米填料来分析它们对电解质性能的影响。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 和电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 进行结构和电化学表征。 XRD 分析显示，TiO2 的掺入使结晶度显着降低，而 FTIR 则表明聚合物、盐和填料之间存在很强的相互作用。添加纳米填料后离子电导率显着增加，在 4 wt.% TiO2 时达到最大值 10.4 mS cm-1。这些发现强调了纳米填料在高电导率 GPE 中的有益作用，为在电化学系统中开发安全高效的凝胶电解质提供了广阔的前景。

full_list.title_en: Agroforestry enhances soil quality and carbon storage with carbon-credit potential across contrasting land-use systems in the Western Ghats
full_list.title_zh: 农林业通过西高止山脉对比土地利用系统的碳信用潜力提高土壤质量和碳储存
full_list.abstract: Agroforestry systems can improve soil quality and carbon storage while generating additional economic value through carbon financing. This study evaluated forest, coffee agroforestry (Coffee AF), rubber agroforestry (Rubber AF), mango agroforestry (Mango AF), and sole-cropping systems for soil quality, soil organic carbon (SOC) storage, biomass carbon accumulation, and indicative carbon-finance potential in the Western Ghats of Karnataka, India. SOC was assessed throughout the soil profile to capture both surface and subsurface carbon pools. Soil quality index (SQI) was higher under Coffee AF (0.655), Rubber AF (0.617), and Mango AF (0.550) than sole cropping (0.499) at 0–30 cm. Surface SOC stocks ranged from 16.6 to 88.3 Mg C ha⁻¹, with Coffee AF showing greater surface SOC storage, whereas Rubber AF recorded the highest deep-soil carbon storage. Relative to sole cropping, annual soil-C accumulation potential was 8.1, 3.8 and 0.76 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ at 0–30 cm and 4.41, 5.17 and 4.12 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ at 30–100 cm for Coffee AF, Rubber AF and Mango AF, respectively. Biomass carbon reached 68.9, 28.8 and 22.5 t C ha⁻¹ in Rubber AF, Coffee AF and Mango AF, with annual woody biomass removal potentials of 11.8, 4.6 and 3.7 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, respectively. Indicative gross carbon-finance value was highest for Rubber AF (USD 415.5 ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹), followed by Coffee AF (USD 338.3) and Mango AF (USD 167.3). Overall, agroforestry provides combined soil, carbon-storage and economic benefits, with Rubber AF particularly promising for deep-soil carbon storage and carbon-finance potential.
full_list.abstract_zh: 农林业系统可以改善土壤质量和碳储存，同时通过碳融资产生额外的经济价值。本研究评估了印度卡纳塔克邦西高止山脉的森林、咖啡农林业 (Coffee AF)、橡胶农林业 (Rubber AF)、芒果农林业 (Mango AF) 和单一种植系统的土壤质量、土壤有机碳 (SOC) 储存、生物量碳积累和指示性碳融资潜力。对整个土壤剖面的 SOC 进行评估，以捕获地表和地下碳库。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 农林业系统可以改善土壤质量和碳储存，同时通过碳融资产生额外的经济价值。本研究评估了印度卡纳塔克邦西高止山脉的森林、咖啡农林业 (Coffee AF)、橡胶农林业 (Rubber AF)、芒果农林业 (Mango AF) 和单一种植系统的土壤质量、土壤有机碳 (SOC) 储存、生物量碳积累和指示性碳融资潜力。对整个土壤剖面的 SOC 进行评估，以捕获地表和地下碳库。在 0-30 厘米处，咖啡 AF (0.655)、橡胶 AF (0.617) 和芒果 AF (0.550) 的土壤质量指数 (SQI) 高于单作 (0.499)。表面 SOC 储量范围为 16.6 至 88.3 Mg C ha⁻1，其中咖啡 AF 显示出更大的表面 SOC 存储量，而橡胶 AF 记录了最高的深层土壤碳存储量。相对于单作，咖啡 AF、橡胶 AF 和芒果 AF 在 0-30 cm 处的土壤年碳积累潜力分别为 8.1、3.8 和 0.76 t CO2e ha⁻1 年，在 30-100 cm 处分别为 4.41、5.17 和 4.12 t CO2e ha⁻1 年。橡胶AF、咖啡AF和芒果AF的生物质碳达到68.9、28.8和22.5吨C ha⁻1，年木本生物量去除潜力分别为11.8、4.6和3.7吨CO2e ha⁻1年。橡胶 AF 的指示性碳融资总额最高（每公顷每年 415.5 美元），其次是咖啡 AF（338.3 美元）和芒果 AF（167.3 美元）。总体而言，农林业提供了土壤、碳储存和经济效益的综合效益，而橡胶AF在深层土壤碳储存和碳融资潜力方面尤其有前景。

full_list.title_en: Agulhas Current Variability and Ocean Heat Transport Implications for Regional Climate Variability and Extreme Ocean Conditions
full_list.title_zh: 厄加勒斯海流变化和海洋热传输对区域气候变化和极端海洋条件的影响
full_list.abstract: The Agulhas Current is one of the strongest western boundary currents of the global ocean and plays a fundamental role in the exchange of heat and salt between the Indian and Atlantic Oceans through the Agulhas leakage system. Variability in the current influences regional circulation, inter-basin exchange, and potentially the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). Despite its climatic importance, the relative roles of atmospheric forcing, large-scale climate variability, and intrinsic ocean dynamics in controlling Agulhas Current transport remain incompletely understood. This study investigates the mean structure, transport variability, heat transport characteristics, and forcing mechanisms of the Agulhas Current using an Eulerian framework based on ocean reanalysis and atmospheric datasets. The mean circulation is characterized by a narrow, surface-intensified western boundary current extending to depths of approximately 800–1000 m, followed by a pronounced retroflection south of Africa. Volume transport estimates reveal a persistent southward flow with a mean transport of approximately 63 Sv and substantial variability (standard deviation ≈ 21 Sv), indicating a highly dynamic current system. Spectral and time-series analyses show that variability is dominated by interannual and longer-timescale fluctuations, with only weak seasonal modulation and no significant long-term trend. Comparison with the Niño-3.4 and Dipole Mode Index (DMI) indicates episodic correspondence with ENSO and Indian Ocean Dipole variability, but no robust or consistent relationship. Heat transport diagnostics demonstrate that the Agulhas Current is a major pathway for poleward heat redistribution in the southwestern Indian Ocean. Meridional heat transport is strongly concentrated within the upper ocean and closely follows the velocity structure of the current, indicating that variations in current strength directly modulate thermal energy transport. Analysis of wind stress curl reveals only a weak relationship with transport variability (r ≈ 0.11), with no significant lagged response or coherent spatial structure, suggesting that local atmospheric forcing plays a minor role in controlling transport fluctuations. Composite analyses of extreme transport states show that variability is primarily associated with changes in current intensity rather than shifts in position. High-transport periods are characterized by a strengthened and coherent current core, whereas low-transport periods exhibit weakened and fragmented flow structures. These results indicate that Agulhas Current variability is governed predominantly by intrinsic ocean dynamics, mesoscale instability, and large-scale circulation adjustments rather than direct local wind forcing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 厄加勒斯洋流是全球海洋最强的西边界洋流之一，通过厄加勒斯渗漏系统在印度洋和大西洋之间的热量和盐交换中发挥着基础作用。洋流的变化会影响区域环流、流域间交换，并可能影响大西洋经向翻转环流 (AMOC)。尽管其对气候具有重要意义，但大气强迫、大规模气候变率和内在海洋动力学在控制厄加勒斯洋流输送方面的相对作用仍不完全清楚。本研究使用基于海洋再分析和大气数据集的欧拉框架，研究了厄加勒斯洋流的平均结构、输运变化、热输运特征和强迫机制。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 厄加勒斯洋流是全球海洋最强的西边界洋流之一，通过厄加勒斯渗漏系统在印度洋和大西洋之间的热量和盐交换中发挥着基础作用。洋流的变化会影响区域环流、流域间交换，并可能影响大西洋经向翻转环流 (AMOC)。尽管其对气候具有重要意义，但大气强迫、大规模气候变率和内在海洋动力学在控制厄加勒斯洋流输送方面的相对作用仍不完全清楚。本研究使用基于海洋再分析和大气数据集的欧拉框架，研究了厄加勒斯洋流的平均结构、输运变化、热输运特征和强迫机制。平均环流的特点是狭窄、表面强化的西边界流延伸至约 800-1000 米的深度，随后在非洲南部出现明显的逆反射。体积输运估计揭示了持续向南的流动，平均输运约为 63 Sv 和显着的变化（标准差 ≈ 21 Sv），表明存在高度动态的水流系统。光谱和时间序列分析表明，变异性以年际和较长时间尺度的波动为主，只有微弱的季节性调制，没有显着的长期趋势。与 Niño-3.4 和偶极模态指数 (DMI) 的比较表明，与 ENSO 和印度洋偶极子变率存在偶发性对应关系，但没有稳健或一致的关系。热传输诊断表明，厄加勒斯洋流是西南印度洋向极地热量重新分配的主要通道。经向热传输强烈集中在上层海洋内，并密切遵循洋流的速度结构，表明洋流强度的变化直接调节热能传输。风应力旋度分析表明，与输运变化的关系较弱（r ≈ 0.11），没有显着的滞后响应或相干的空间结构，表明局部大气强迫在控制输运波动中起着次要作用。极端输运状态的综合分析表明，变异性主要与电流强度的变化有关，而不是与位置的变化有关。高输运周期的特点是增强和相干的电流核心，而低输运周期则表现出减弱和分散的流动结构。这些结果表明，厄加勒斯洋流的变化主要受内在海洋动力学、中尺度不稳定性和大规模环流调整的影响，而不是直接的局部风力强迫。
full_list.summary: 厄加勒斯洋流是全球海洋最强的西边界洋流之一，通过厄加勒斯渗漏系统在印度洋和大西洋之间的热量和盐交换中发挥着基础作用。洋流的变化会影响区域环流、流域间交换，并可能影响大西洋经向翻转环流 (AMOC)。尽管其对气候具有重要意义，但大气强迫、大规模气候变率和内在海洋动力学在控制厄加勒斯洋流输送方面的相对作用仍不完全清楚。本研究使用基于海洋再分析和大气数据集的欧拉框架，研究了厄加勒斯洋流的平均结构、输运变化、热输运特征和强迫机制。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《厄加勒斯海流变化和海洋热传输对区域气候变化和极端海洋条件的影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Biological and comparative genomic characterization of Staphylococcus aureus phage SJP49-2 and its effects on biofilm biomass
full_list.title_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌噬菌体 SJP49-2 的生物学和比较基因组特征及其对生物膜生物量的影响
full_list.abstract: Background Biofilms complicate control of Staphylococcus aureus in food-related environments, and susceptibility to phages varies among strains. This study characterized phage SJP49-2 using morphology, lysis coverage across 92 laboratory-maintained strains, environmental stability, culture propagation, planktonic growth, biofilm biomass and a beef surface model. Host and phage genomes were analyzed, and SJP49-2 was compared with 19 reference phage genomes. Phenotypic assays were conducted as single experiments with technical replication and descriptive analysis.Results SJP49-2 showed lysis against 64 of 92 strains (69.57%). At the highest tested doses, crystal violet signals during biofilm formation and after treatment of established biofilms were 79.36% and 94.80% lower than their controls, respectively. In beef, the inoculation scheme at a multiplicity of infection of 1000 had an 8 h bacterial count 2.08 log₁₀ units below the control and a rise from its own baseline 0.45 log₁₀ units smaller than the control; starting counts differed with the inoculation schemes. Sequencing generated 2,461,307 raw and 2,377,351 filtered read pairs. The 44,239 bp assembly contained no ambiguous bases, had a GC content of 35.38% and contained 69 GeneMarkS-predicted coding sequences with 93.13% nonoverlapping genomic coverage. Genomic annotations supported temperate potential; general protein-product discrepancies qualified the interpretation of negative database screens. The existing 20-genome comparison contained 383 gene clusters, including 11 strict core clusters.Conclusions SJP49-2 exhibited antibacterial and biofilm-biomass-reducing phenotypes under the tested conditions. The beef observations were consistent with growth limitation within the tested inoculation schemes. Its genomic features and candidate antibacterial proteins provide a basis for further investigation of phage–host interactions and food-related biocontrol.
full_list.abstract_zh: 背景生物膜使食品相关环境中金黄色葡萄球菌的控制变得复杂，并且不同菌株对噬菌体的敏感性不同。本研究利用形态学、92 个实验室维护菌株的裂解覆盖率、环境稳定性、培养物繁殖、浮游生长、生物膜生物量和牛肉表面模型来表征噬菌体 SJP49-2。对宿主和噬菌体基因组进行了分析，并将 SJP49-2 与 19 个参考噬菌体基因组进行了比较。表型测定作为单一实验进行，并进行了技术复制和描述性分析。结果 SJP49-2 显示对 92 个菌株中的 64 个菌株进行裂解 (69.57%)。

full_list.title_en: Characterization of unsteady dynamics and loss mechanisms in supersonic turbine trailing-edge flows
full_list.title_zh: 超音速涡轮后缘流动的非定常动力学特征和损失机制
full_list.abstract: This study investigates trailing-edge flow physics in a linear supersonic turbine cascade using wall-resolved large-eddy simulations. Three inlet Mach numbers (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)), ((2.00)), and ((2.15))) are considered at a fixed Reynolds number of ((Re=395,000)) to assess the influence of shock-boundary-layer interactions (SBLIs) on the trailing-edge dynamics. Variations in Mach number shift the SBLIs downstream, causing the suction-side interaction to merge with the trailing-edge recirculation region for ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) and ((2.15)). Cases with an SBLI located near the trailing edge also exhibit amplified pressure fluctuations within the shock–trailing-edge interaction region. Spectral analysis shows that the trailing-edge shocks are dominated by low- and mid-frequency unsteadiness, with increasing Mach number shifting the dominant content toward lower frequencies. Calculation of mass flux over the bubble surface reveals a strongly asymmetric exchange across the trailing-edge separation region, with larger mass-flux magnitudes along the suction-side interface. Temporal correlations indicate that bubble expansions and contractions precede the trailing-edge shock-system response, which is highly synchronized when a large shock-induced separation bubble forms near the trailing edge. Along the wake, increasing Mach number enhances the pressure and density asymmetry between the blade surfaces, which deflects the flow toward the lower-density stream on the suction side. Spectral proper orthogonal decomposition identifies Kelvin-Helmholtz-type coherent structures at higher frequencies along the wake, with similar modal topologies for all cases. Finally, entropy-generation analysis shows that viscous dissipation dominates the aerodynamic losses, primarily within the suction-side boundary layer, whereas the wake contributes only a minor fraction.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究使用壁分辨大涡模拟研究线性超音速涡轮叶栅中的后缘流动物理场。在固定雷诺数 ((Re=395,000)) 下考虑三个入口马赫数 (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85))、((2.00)) 和 ((2.15)))，以评估激波边界层相互作用 (SBLI) 对后缘动力学的影响。马赫数的变化使 SBLI 向下游移动，导致吸力侧相互作用与后缘再循环区域合并 ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) 和 ((2.15))。 SBLI 位于后缘附近的情况也在激波-后缘相互作用区域内表现出放大的压力波动。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究使用壁分辨大涡模拟研究线性超音速涡轮叶栅中的后缘流动物理场。在固定雷诺数 ((Re=395,000)) 下考虑三个入口马赫数 (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85))、((2.00)) 和 ((2.15)))，以评估激波边界层相互作用 (SBLI) 对后缘动力学的影响。马赫数的变化使 SBLI 向下游移动，导致吸力侧相互作用与后缘再循环区域合并 ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) 和 ((2.15))。 SBLI 位于后缘附近的情况也在激波-后缘相互作用区域内表现出放大的压力波动。谱分析表明，后缘激波以低频和中频不定常为主，随着马赫数的增加，主导内容向低频方向移动。气泡表面质量通量的计算揭示了后缘分离区域的强烈不对称交换，沿吸力侧界面具有更大的质量通量值。时间相关性表明气泡膨胀和收缩先于后缘激波系统响应，当在后缘附近形成大的激波引起的分离气泡时，后缘激波系统响应是高度同步的。沿着尾流，马赫数的增加会增强叶片表面之间的压力和密度不对称性，从而使气流偏向吸力侧的较低密度流。谱本征正交分解可识别沿尾流的较高频率下的开尔文-亥姆霍兹型相干结构，所有情况都具有相似的模态拓扑。最后，熵产生分析表明，粘性耗散在空气动力学损失中占主导地位，主要是在吸力侧边界层内，而尾流仅贡献一小部分。

full_list.title_en: Decoupling of the dynamic and subsurface thermal expressions of the climatological semiannual Rossby wave in the Bay of Bengal
full_list.title_zh: 孟加拉湾气候半年罗斯贝波的动力和地下热表达的解耦
full_list.abstract: The climatological semiannual Rossby wave of the Bay of Bengal is usually described from altimetric sea level anomaly (SLA) alone, on the assumption that sea level and subsurface temperature are interchangeable. We test this with 22 years (2004–2025) of altimetry and Argo data, using a plane-wave projection, a layer-wise steric decomposition and normal-mode solutions. Coherent westward propagation is confined to 7–11°N, 81–90°E, where direction purity exceeds 0.65. Only the subsurface thermal expression recovers a single freely propagating first-mode wave: the 160 m temperature, the 20°C isotherm depth and the 100–300 m steric height all give a wavelength near 18°, a speed of 12.6–12.9 cm s⁻¹ and 0.97–0.98 of the variance explained by one plane wave. SLA is compressed to 11.8° and 8.3 cm s⁻¹ and drifts in phase by up to 1.1 month, because part of the semiannual steric height is quasi-standing in the upper 100 m; removing that layer restores a 19.7° wave. The apparent amplitude decoupling is a normalization artifact: scaled with the observed thermocline displacement, the westward 160 m temperature component matches heaving to within 9%. Confining mode 1 to a 3° band reproduces the observed speed, whereas the two-dimensional mode is twice as fast, so the along-path speed variation in altimetry reflects interference rather than changing stratification. The winter–spring crest reaches the western boundary in February–April, deepening the thermocline by 10 m, while the summer–autumn event is cancelled by the annual cycle. A single altimetric view can misrepresent a baroclinic wave in a freshwater-influenced basin.

full_list.title_en: Differential Deformation and Retrogressive Evolution of the Linbang Landslide with Multiple Slip Surfaces under Reservoir Water-Level Fluctuations
full_list.title_zh: 水库水位升降下林浜多滑面滑坡的差异变形与回归演化
full_list.abstract: Fluctuations in reservoir water level are a major cause of the reactivation of ancient landslides along reservoir banks, yet for deposits controlled by weak intercalated zones, the differences in deformation response among individual sliding masses and the traction between them remain poorly understood. Taking the Linbang ancient landslide deposit in the Houziyan Reservoir of the Dadu River as a case study, this paper integrates SBAS-InSAR deformation identification, field monitoring, a large-scale physical model test and coupled seepage-stress numerical simulation to investigate the differential deformation of the sliding masses and the mechanism of traction-driven evolution under reservoir water level fluctuations. The results show that: (i) before impoundment, deformation was concentrated at the front edge and expanded towards the middle and rear parts after impoundment; the maximum cumulative displacement in the field reached 4674.94 mm, and accelerated deformation occurred mainly during the drawdown period from December to May, allowing the landslide to be divided into a strongly deformed front zone, a traction zone in the middle and a passively dragged zone at the rear. (ii) The physical model reproduced the initial impoundment and five subsequent water level cycles; seven cracks developed, and the maximum surface change obtained by 3D laser scanning increased from 2.75 cm in the first cycle to 3.68 cm in the fifth, with deformation propagating successively from J3 to J2 and J1, indicating retrogressive extension from the front towards the rear. (iii) Initial impoundment softened and settled the submerged sliding masses, weakening their support for the upper masses; during drawdown, internal drainage lagged behind the falling reservoir level, generating an outward seepage force superimposed on the downslope component, with pore pressure peaks lagging behind water level peaks; the strongly weathered phyllite-dominated mass, with high water retention and relatively slow drainage, is an important control on the stepwise deformation during drawdown. (iv) Numerical simulation further indicates that during water level rise the inward seepage force and external hydrostatic pressure provide a stabilizing contribution, whereas larger drawdown rates or higher rainfall intensities increase the reduction in stability. The deformation of the Linbang landslide is governed by traction between sliding masses, showing the staged characteristics of acceleration during initial impoundment, stepwise movement during drawdown and deceleration during the subsequent rise.

full_list.title_en: Dynamic Stabilization of Biped Robots on Compound Terrains via Upper- Body Compensated Hybrid Switching ZMP Control
full_list.title_zh: 通过上半身补偿混合开关 ZMP 控制实现复合地形上双足机器人的动态稳定
full_list.abstract: This paper presents a simulation-based study on dynamic stability control of a planar biped robot walking over compound terrains consisting of flat surfaces, inclined planes, and stair steps. The locomotion problem is modeled as a hybrid switching system, in which discrete transitions between single-support and double-support phases are coordinated through a phase-dependent switching control strategy. For each phase, smooth and continuous joint trajectories are generated using cubic spline interpolation. Dynamic balance is assessed and regulated through a Switching Zero- Moment Point (ZMP)-based criterion, where the admissible stability region is updated according to the active support phase and its corresponding support polygon. A key contribution of this work is the integration of upper-body mass compensation into the switching ZMP framework. By explicitly incorporating the torso contribution into the dynamic model and adjusting upper-body motion across gait transitions, corrective moments are generated to keep the ZMP within the admissible region under varying terrain conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed hybrid switching controller improves trajectory tracking, enhances ZMP regulation, and preserves stable locomotion across compound and uneven walking surfaces. .
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的研究，研究平面双足机器人在由平坦表面、斜面和楼梯台阶组成的复合地形上行走的动态稳定性控制。运动问题被建模为混合切换系统，其中单支撑和双支撑阶段之间的离散转换通过阶段相关的切换控制策略进行协调。对于每个阶段，使用三次样条插值生成平滑且连续的关节轨迹。动态平衡通过基于切换零力矩点 (ZMP) 的标准进行评估和调节，其中允许的稳定性区域根据活动支撑相位及其相应的支撑多边形进行更新。这项工作的一个关键贡献是将上身质量补偿集成到切换 ZMP 框架中。

full_list.title_en: Effectiveness of raw eucalypt pole pre-supply operations in reducing surface and end checking in electricity distribution poles in Uganda
full_list.title_zh: 原桉树杆预供应操作在减少乌干达配电杆表面和端部检查方面的有效性
full_list.abstract: Premature failure of utility poles is a significant problem in Uganda, leading to substantial financial losses, operational disruption and safety risks. Among several factors that cause premature failure, it is critical to note that, frequent development of drying defects such as surface checksand end splits compromise the mechanical strength and durability of the poles. This study sought to contribute to the durability of treated poles by evaluating the effectiveness of three different pre-seasoning interventions, pre-felling girdling, bark girdling post-felling, and foliage retention post-felling in reducing surface and end checks in Eucalyptus grandis x camaldulensis. A sample of 100 poles was divided into four groups – the control and three treatment groups “Treatment 1 – pre-felling girdling, Treatment 2 – bark girdling post-felling, and Treatment 3 – foliage retention post-felling”. Over a period of five months, regular measurements of moisture content, check length, width, and depth were taken. The treatments were effective in reducing the number of checks compared to the control group. Specifically, Treatment 3 (foliage retention after felling) was the most effective in reducing check depth, with a mean of 60.60 mm compared to 74.83 mm for the control. Overall, the control group exhibited the highest values for check number, depth and width across all groups.  Based on these findings, it is recommended that pole suppliers in Uganda adopt these practices to improve the durability of their products. Further research is necessary to explore the combined effects of these treatments and to determine the effective duration for girdling.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电线杆过早失效是乌干达的一个严重问题，会导致重大财务损失、运营中断和安全风险。在导致过早失效的几个因素中，值得注意的是，频繁出现的干燥缺陷（例如表面裂纹和端部裂口）会损害电线杆的机械强度和耐用性。本研究试图通过评估三种不同的预干燥干预措施（采伐前环剥、采伐后树皮环剥以及采伐后保留树叶）在减少巨桉 x 赤桉表面和末端检查方面的有效性，来提高经过处理的杆的耐用性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电线杆过早失效是乌干达的一个严重问题，会导致重大财务损失、运营中断和安全风险。在导致过早失效的几个因素中，值得注意的是，频繁出现的干燥缺陷（例如表面裂纹和端部裂口）会损害电线杆的机械强度和耐用性。本研究试图通过评估三种不同的预干燥干预措施（采伐前环剥、采伐后树皮环剥以及采伐后保留树叶）在减少巨桉 x 赤桉表面和末端检查方面的有效性，来提高经过处理的杆的耐用性。将 100 根杆子样本分为四组 - 对照组和三个处理组“处理 1 - 砍伐前环剥，处理 2 - 砍伐后树皮环剥，处理 3 - 砍伐后保留叶子”。在五个月的时间内，定期测量水分含量、支票长度、宽度和深度。与对照组相比，这些治疗有效减少了检查次数。具体而言，处理 3（砍伐后保留叶子）在减少检查深度方面最有效，平均为 60.60 毫米，而对照组为 74.83 毫米。总体而言，对照组在所有组中显示出最高的检查数量、深度和宽度值。  根据这些发现，建议乌干达的电线杆供应商采用这些做法来提高其产品的耐用性。需要进一步的研究来探索这些处理的综合效果并确定环剥的有效持续时间。

full_list.title_en: Emergent mesoscale nanoparticle patterns from a non-equilibrium liquid lens
full_list.title_zh: 非平衡液体透镜中出现的介观纳米颗粒图案
full_list.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 14 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79569-4 Nanoparticle assembly at fluid interfaces is often viewed as unpredictable and dominated by uncontrolled non-equilibrium effects. Here, the authors show that evaporation-driven nanoparticle assembly reveals predictable morphologies through multiscale modeling, linking transport dynamics and kinetic arrest.
full_list.abstract_zh: 流体界面处的纳米粒子组装通常被认为是不可预测的，并且受不受控制的非平衡效应支配。在这里，作者表明，蒸发驱动的纳米颗粒组装通过多尺度建模揭示了可预测的形态，将传输动力学和动力学停滞联系起来。

full_list.title_en: Enhancing solar conversion efficiency of CdTe-based absorber solar cells via SCAPS-1D simulation
full_list.title_zh: 通过 SCAPS-1D 模拟提高 CdTe 基吸收太阳能电池的太阳能转换效率
full_list.abstract: The growing global energy demand and the need for new sources have driven significant advancements in energy storage technologies, which are essential for improving energy sustainability and efficiency. Cadmium telluride (CdTe) is one of the most efficient and cost-effective thin-film solar cell materials with an ideal band gap between 1.44 eV and 1.5 eV. CdTe is a long-standing material in the fabrication of solar cells for its ideal band gap and high optical absorption coefficient. This is a promising material due to its efficient devices and cost ratio because of its large flexibility in the manufacturing process. Due to its properties, CdTe has been regarded as a material for producing high-efficiency solar cells. In the ideal band gap range, which is suitable for the solar cell spectrum and maximum absorption (more than 90%) of incoming photons at a thickness of 2 µm. CdTe is the absorber; the cadmium sulphide (CdS) film and the back contact are the typical layers that make up the conventional structure of a superstrate CdTe solar cell. An absorber layer with Nickel oxide (NiO) as the window layer was investigated in order to enhance the Photovoltaic (PV) system’s device features as well as parameters. To assess the effectiveness of the thin-film solar cell architectures, can be modelled utilising computer simulations. The efficiency of CdTe Photovoltaic (PV) cells was found to be 27.7% by simulation in SCAPS-1D simulation software.

full_list.title_en: Geometry-Aware Depth Anomaly Detection and Adaptive Decision Modeling for Automated Robotic Quality Sorting
full_list.title_zh: 用于自动机器人质量分拣的几何感知深度异常检测和自适应决策建模
full_list.abstract: Industrial 3D anomaly detection remains challenging when defective surface structures must be distinguished from normal geometric variations across different industrial components. This study presents a geometry-aware anomaly detection framework that integrates local surface characteristics with global object-shape descriptors for industrial defect identification and localization. The proposed framework is evaluated using the MVTec 3D-AD benchmark, comprising 4,147 industrial 3D scans across ten object categories. Local geometric characteristics, including surface normals, curvature, depth variation, and neighborhood consistency, are combined with global descriptors, including convexity, solidity, and void ratio, to construct a complementary geometric representation. The experimental evaluation examines conventional geometric thresholding, an unsupervised 3D anomaly detection baseline, and the proposed local–global feature-fusion approach. Image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level defect localization are assessed using AUROC, average precision, Intersection over Union, and Dice similarity. Feature-ablation analysis investigates the respective contributions of local and global geometric representations. Furthermore, anomaly severity and prediction uncertainty are incorporated into a three-action quality-inspection strategy comprising acceptance, rejection, and additional inspection. The sorting component is evaluated through a cost-sensitive simulation that considers false acceptance, false rejection, and additional-inspection requirements. The study connects geometric anomaly detection with uncertainty-aware quality control decision modeling and investigates the contribution of complementary geometric information to automated industrial inspection. Physical robotic deployment and validation under actual manufacturing conditions remain outside the scope of this experimental evaluation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当必须将有缺陷的表面结构与不同工业组件的正常几何变化区分开来时，工业 3D 异常检测仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种几何感知异常检测框架，该框架将局部表面特征与全局对象形状描述符相结合，用于工业缺陷识别和定位。所提出的框架使用 MVTec 3D-AD 基准进行评估，其中包括 10 个对象类别的 4,147 个工业 3D 扫描。局部几何特征（包括表面法线、曲率、深度变化和邻域一致性）与全局描述符（包括凸度、坚固性和空隙率）相结合，以构建互补的几何表示。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《通过钙钛矿结晶优化和无金属互连层实现高效钙钛矿有机串联太阳能电池》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《局部构型亚稳态加速高熵钙钛矿中的氧交换》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Multiscale Thermal Transport in AlPO-18 for Heat-Transformation Applications
full_list.title_zh: 用于热转换应用的 AlPO-18 中的多尺度热传输
full_list.abstract: A multiscale analysis of framework dynamics, negative thermal expansion, and heat transport is presented for AlPO-18, with explicit distinction between crystallographic cell conventions and transport operators. The calcined conventional C2/c cell contains Al₂₄P₂₄O₉₆, 144 atoms, and has a volume of 3241.81 Å³, whereas the corresponding 72-atom primitive cell has a volume of 1620.90 Å³. The calculated elastic tensor is positive definite, with stiffness eigenvalues ranging from 13.9 to 222 GPa. The Reuss bulk, shear, and Young moduli are 73.56, 19.34, and 53.35 GPa, respectively. Variable-temperature diffraction reveals a volume contraction of 0.91% between 105 and 455 K. The volumetric thermal-expansion coefficient remains negative throughout this interval, changing from − 30.75 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 105 K to − 22.41 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 455 K, with a value of − 26.18 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 298 K. No thermal-expansion crossover is observed. Analysis of the local T···T distances and the eight-membered-ring span shows that the contraction is governed primarily by transverse Al–O–P hinging and cooperative tetrahedral rotations rather than uniform bond shortening. A 216-branch harmonic spectrum, Raman comparison, charge-density redistribution, and heat-capacity-weighted mode analysis associate this structural flexibility with low-frequency collective framework vibrations. The transport analysis distinguishes three physically different conductivity baselines: 1.150 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the periodic Wigner total, 0.773 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the reservoir Monte Carlo population target, and 0.370 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the boundary-limited platelet response. These values correspond to different operators, geometries, and channel definitions and therefore do not represent competing estimates of a single bulk conductivity. A gray two-stream benchmark gives a statistical convergence slope of − 0.53 and approaches the diffusive limit within 2% for L/Λ ≥ 98. Boundary calculations and AlPO-18/PVOH coating transients further demonstrate how thickness, surface specularity, and coupled heat and mass transfer modify the intrinsic framework response. The study establishes a quantitatively consistent connection between cell normalization, macroscopic contraction, framework vibrations, transport channels, and application-scale thermal behaviour in AlPO-18.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对 AlPO-18 的框架动力学、负热膨胀和热传输进行了多尺度分析，并明确区分了晶体单元约定和传输算子。煅烧后的传统C2/c电池含有Al24P24O96、144个原子，体积为3241.81 Å3，而相应的72原子原始电池的体积为1620.90 Å3。计算出的弹性张量是正定的，刚度特征值范围为 13.9 至 222 GPa。罗伊斯体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量分别为 73.56、19.34 和 53.35 GPa。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 对 AlPO-18 的框架动力学、负热膨胀和热传输进行了多尺度分析，并明确区分了晶体单元约定和传输算子。煅烧后的传统C2/c电池含有Al24P24O96、144个原子，体积为3241.81 Å3，而相应的72原子原始电池的体积为1620.90 Å3。计算出的弹性张量是正定的，刚度特征值范围为 13.9 至 222 GPa。罗伊斯体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量分别为 73.56、19.34 和 53.35 GPa。变温衍射显示，在 105 至 455 K 之间，体积收缩了 0.91%。在此期间，体积热膨胀系数保持为负值，从 105 K 时的 − 30.75 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻1 变化到 455 K 时的 − 22.41 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻1，其值为- 26.18 × 10-6 K-1 (298 K)。未观察到热膨胀交叉。对局部 T·T 距离和八元环跨度的分析表明，收缩主要由横向 Al-O-P 铰接和协作四面体旋转决定，而不是均匀的键缩短。 216 分支谐波谱、拉曼比较、电荷密度重新分布和热容加权模式分析将这种结构灵活性与低频集体框架振动联系起来。输运分析区分了三个物理上不同的电导率基线：周期性维格纳总电导率基线为 1.150 W m-1 K-1，储库蒙特卡罗群体目标为 0.773 W m-1 K-1，边界限制血小板响应为 0.370 W m-1 K-1。这些值对应于不同的操作员、几何形状和通道定义，因此并不代表单个体电导率的竞争估计。灰色双流基准给出了 - 0.53 的统计收敛斜率，并且在 L/Λ ≥ 98 的情况下接近 2% 以内的扩散极限。边界计算和 AlPO-18/PVOH 涂层瞬态进一步证明了厚度、表面镜面度和耦合热质传递如何改变内在框架响应。该研究在 AlPO-18 中的细胞标准化、宏观收缩、框架振动、传输通道和应用规模热行为之间建立了定量一致的联系。

full_list.title_en: Quantitative Mapping of Hidden Structural Relaxation and Heterogeneity in Sputtered IGZO Thin Films Using 4D-STEM RDF Analysis
full_list.title_zh: 使用 4D-STEM RDF 分析定量绘制溅射 IGZO 薄膜中隐藏的结构弛豫和异质性
full_list.abstract: Amorphous indium–gallium–zinc oxide (a-IGZO) is a widely used channel material for thin-film transistors (TFTs), where post-deposition annealing is used to optimize their device performance. However, conventional characterization techniques, such as X-ray diffraction (XRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM), have limited sensitivity to detect the subtle and nanoscale structural evolution, including local atomic rearrangements and nanocrystal nucleation, that precedes macroscopic crystallization and may affect charge transport. To overcome this, we combined four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) with spatially resolved radial distribution function (RDF) analysis to map the structural evolution of a-IGZO films as a function of annealing temperature. Although XRD and HRTEM revealed no discernible crystallization up to 500°C, our RDF analysis detected a shift toward shorter distances and a broadening of the metal–oxygen bond distance distribution with increasing annealing temperature, indicating non-uniform local structural relaxation. This nanoscale densification and rearrangement may explain the non-monotonic temperature dependence of the sheet resistance, which decreases up to an annealing temperature of 400°C and increases at higher temperatures. Our 4D-STEM RDF analysis resolves structural dynamics preceding crystallization that remain beyond the detection limits of conventional characterization techniques, thereby providing a new metric to guide process optimization in amorphous oxide semiconductors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 非晶氧化铟镓锌 (a-IGZO) 是一种广泛用于薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 的沟道材料，采用沉积后退火来优化其器件性能。然而，传统的表征技术，如 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM)，对于检测细微的纳米级结构演化（包括局部原子重排和纳米晶体成核）的灵敏度有限，这些演化先于宏观结晶并可能影响电荷传输。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 非晶氧化铟镓锌 (a-IGZO) 是一种广泛用于薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 的沟道材料，采用沉积后退火来优化其器件性能。然而，传统的表征技术，如 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM)，对于检测细微的纳米级结构演化（包括局部原子重排和纳米晶体成核）的灵敏度有限，这些演化先于宏观结晶并可能影响电荷传输。为了克服这个问题，我们将四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 与空间分辨径向分布函数 (RDF) 分析相结合，以绘制 a-IGZO 薄膜的结构演变随退火温度的变化。尽管 XRD 和 HRTEM 显示在高达 500°C 的温度下没有明显的结晶，但我们的 RDF 分析检测到随着退火温度的升高，金属-氧键距分布向更短的距离转变，并且变宽，表明局部结构松弛不均匀。这种纳米级致密化和重排可以解释方块电阻的非单调温度依赖性，当退火温度达到 400°C 时，方块电阻会降低，并在更高的温度下增加。我们的 4D-STEM RDF 分析解决了结晶之前的结构动力学问题，该结构动力学仍然超出了传统表征技术的检测极限，从而提供了一个新的指标来指导非晶氧化物半导体的工艺优化。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用 4D-STEM RDF 分析定量绘制溅射 IGZO 薄膜中隐藏的结构弛豫和异质性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Regional Ocean Conditions Shape Mesoscale Eddy Thermal Responses to ENSO Diversity in the Subtropical Southeastern Indian Ocean
full_list.title_zh: 区域海洋条件影响副热带东南印度洋ENSO多样性的中尺度涡热响应
full_list.abstract: Satellite altimetry, Argo profiles, and ocean reanalysis are used to examine mesoscale eddy thermal responses to eastern-Pacific (EP) and central-Pacific (CP) ENSO in the subtropical southeastern Indian Ocean. Anticyclonic temperature anomalies relative to climatology broadly follow regional background changes. During EP-El Niño, eastern subsurface cooling and central shallow warming coincide with weaker eastern but strong central warm-core anomalies. Leeuwin Current variations suggest that changes in poleward warm-water transport contribute to the eastern temperature response. Cyclonic eddies retain subsurface cold cores under all four ENSO conditions, with pronounced upper-ocean warming producing a warm-over-cold structure during CP-La Niña. Subtracting matched contemporaneous out-of-eddy temperatures preserves these cores and their greater depth in the central sector. The ENSO–shear relationship is stronger for meridional than zonal shear in the eastern Leeuwin Current–Leeuwin Undercurrent system, whereas zonal shear in the central South Indian Countercurrent–South Equatorial Current system is associated with both ENSO indices. These shear changes may affect eddy development through baroclinic instability. Approximately 15–17% of eastern-origin eddies propagate into the central sector and may retain thermal properties acquired upstream. Regional background temperature thus helps explain anticyclonic thermal contrasts, while circulation adjustments and westward propagation may also contribute to subsurface thermal variability.
full_list.abstract_zh: 卫星测高、Argo 剖面和海洋再分析用于研究印度洋东南部副热带东太平洋 (EP) 和中太平洋 (CP) ENSO 的中尺度涡流热响应。与气候学相关的反气旋温度异常大致遵循区域背景变化。东部型厄尔尼诺期间，东部次表层变冷和中部浅层变暖与东部较弱但中部较强的暖核异常同时发生。卢纹海流的变化表明，极地暖水输送的变化有助于东部的温度响应。在所有四种 ENSO 条件下，气旋涡流都保留了地下冷核心，在中部拉尼娜期间，上层海洋明显变暖，产生暖冷结构。

full_list.title_en: Time-varying mesh stiffness for fast force estimation on cracked and healthy double helical gears
full_list.title_zh: 时变啮合刚度，可快速估计有裂纹和健康的双斜齿轮的力
full_list.abstract: Time-Varying-Mesh-Stiffness (TVMS) in the context of gearing has traditionally been studied from a theoretical standpoint. This work strives to summarize in a concise manner notable literature pertaining to TVMS and proposes a methodology to extend its utility to the computation of time-dependent forces on gear flanks. This is done by calculating the share of individual tooth stiffnesses to the total mesh stiffness at any given instant of time, and relating this fraction to the instantaneous distribution of forces amongst the teeth in the mesh, under the assumption of parallel spring configuration. In this paper, the effects of the introduction of a crack in the tooth root is also investigated. Gearbox vibrations and premature tooth failure are often accompanied by time‑varying internal loading that occurs during the mesh‑in and mesh‑out phases of gear‑tooth contact. Direct finite‑element analysis of these forces is computationally prohibitive, motivating the development of an analytical framework based on time‑varying mesh stiffness (TVMS). This work presents a comprehensive TVMS model for double‑helical gear pairs that accommodates both healthy and surface‑cracked teeth. Leveraging a slice‑wise decomposition of the gear tooth—where each infinitesimal spur‑slice contributes a series of bending, shear, axial, fillet, and Hertzian compliances—the model yields closed‑form expressions for the stiffness of individual slices and aggregates them to obtain the total mesh stiffness as a function of roll angle. An explicit algorithm guides the workflow from geometry definition through force computation, including the treatment of crack geometry (straight‑line and parabolic limiting lines) and its influence on cross‑sectional area and moment of inertia. The results demonstrate that the TVMS framework provides a rapid, physics‑based alternative to full FEM analyses for evaluating gear‑tooth forces, assessing the impact of defects, and supporting dynamic‑response studies of high‑speed helical and double‑helical gear trains. Future work will focus on experimental validation and extension to multiple or more complex cracks.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 传统上从理论角度研究齿轮装置中的时变网格刚度 (TVMS)。这项工作力求以简洁的方式总结与 TVMS 相关的著名文献，并提出一种方法，将其实用性扩展到计算齿轮齿面上随时间变化的力。这是通过计算在任何给定时刻单个齿刚度占总啮合刚度的份额，并将该分数与在平行弹簧配置的假设下啮合中齿之间的力的瞬时分布相关联来完成的。在本文中，还研究了在齿根中引入裂纹的影响。齿轮箱振动和过早的齿失效通常伴随着轮齿接触的啮合和啮合阶段发生的时变内部负载。对这些力进行直接有限元分析在计算上是令人望而却步的，这促使了基于时变网格刚度 (TVMS) 的分析框架的开发。这项工作提出了一个全面的双螺旋齿轮副 TVMS 模型，可以容纳健康的牙齿和表面裂纹的牙齿。利用齿轮齿的切片分解（其中每个无穷小的正切片贡献一系列弯曲、剪切、轴向、圆角和赫兹柔量），该模型生成各个切片刚度的闭合形式表达式，并将它们聚合以获得作为滚动角函数的总网格刚度。显式算法指导从几何定义到力计算的工作流程，包括裂纹几何形状（直线和抛物线限制线）的处理及其对横截面积和惯性矩的影响。结果表明，TVMS 框架提供了一种快速、基于物理的替代完整 FEM 分析的方法，用于评估轮齿力、评估缺陷的影响以及支持高速螺旋和双螺旋齿轮系的动态响应研究。未来的工作将侧重于实验验证和扩展到多个或更复杂的裂缝。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《时变啮合刚度，可快速估计有裂纹和健康的双斜齿轮的力》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: In-situ experiments and numerical simulation of ground vibration isolation using concrete row-pile barriers
full_list.title_zh: 混凝土排桩屏障地面隔振现场试验与数值模拟
full_list.abstract: In recent years, ground vibration induced by train operation and other rail-transit activities has become increasingly prominent, creating a growing need for effective vibration isolation measures. This study combines in-situ experiments with finite element simulations to systematically investigate the ground vibration isolation performance of concrete row-pile barriers. Firstly, in-situ experiments were conducted under no-barrier, single-row, and double-row configurations to examine the effects of the number of pile rows and vibration direction on isolation performance. A finite element model was then established and validated against the experimental results. Based on the validated model, parametric analyses were performed to investigate the effects of pile length, pile diameter, pile spacing, number of pile rows, barrier location, and source position. Further dimensionless analysis was conducted by normalizing the pile geometric parameters and source-to-barrier distance with the characteristic Rayleigh wavelength of the site. The results show that the isolation performance of row-pile barriers exhibits pronounced spatial non-uniformity. For single-row barriers, pile length and spacing are the dominant parameters, with effective ranges of approximately 12–16 m and 1–2 m, respectively. For multiple-row barriers, increasing the number of rows improves vibration attenuation but produces diminishing marginal benefits. Local vibration amplification is also observed behind double-row barriers in the near-field oblique region. Finally, the findings provide a scientific basis and engineering reference for the design of concrete row-pile barriers for ground vibration isolation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 近年来，列车运行和其他轨道交通活动引起的地面振动日益突出，对有效隔振措施的需求日益增长。本研究将现场实验与有限元模拟相结合，系统研究混凝土排桩屏障的地面隔振性能。首先，在无障碍、单排和双排三种构型下进行了现场试验，考察桩排数和振动方向对隔震性能的影响。然后建立了有限元模型并根据实验结果进行了验证。基于验证的模型，进行参数分析，研究桩长、桩径、桩距、桩排数、障碍物位置和源位置的影响。通过使用该地点的特征瑞利波长对桩几何参数和源到屏障距离进行归一化，进行了进一步的无量纲分析。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，列车运行和其他轨道交通活动引起的地面振动日益突出，对有效隔振措施的需求日益增长。本研究将现场实验与有限元模拟相结合，系统研究混凝土排桩屏障的地面隔振性能。首先，在无障碍、单排和双排三种构型下进行了现场试验，考察桩排数和振动方向对隔震性能的影响。然后建立了有限元模型并根据实验结果进行了验证。基于验证的模型，进行参数分析，研究桩长、桩径、桩距、桩排数、障碍物位置和源位置的影响。通过使用该地点的特征瑞利波长对桩几何参数和源到屏障距离进行归一化，进行了进一步的无量纲分析。结果表明，排桩屏障的隔震性能表现出明显的空间不均匀性。对于单排护栏，桩长和间距是主要参数，有效范围分别约为 12-16 m 和 1-2 m。对于多排屏障，增加排数可以改善振动衰减，但会产生边际效益递减。在近场倾斜区域的双排势垒后面也观察到局部振动放大。最后，研究结果为地面隔振混凝土排桩屏障的设计提供科学依据和工程参考。
